name: Monk Fruit
aliases: monk fruit, monk fruit extract, monkfruit, luo han guo, luo han guo extract, Siraitia grosvenorii extract, mogroside, mogrosides, mogroside V
what_is: A fruit-derived sweetening ingredient from Siraitia grosvenorii. Commercial monk-fruit sweeteners are typically extracts rich in sweet mogrosides.
why_botia: BOTIA flags explicit monk-fruit and luo-han-guo declarations because they identify a non-sugar sweetening ingredient that may be described by common, botanical or extract names. In the United States, FDA has received GRAS notices for monk-fruit extracts and has not questioned the notified conclusions for the stated uses; that is not the same as a universal approval in every market.
can_1: Detect monk fruit, luo han guo, Siraitia grosvenorii extract and common mogroside declarations.
can_2: Show the sweetener context while keeping U.S. GRAS status distinct from other jurisdictions.
cannot_1: Determine mogroside concentration or sweetness contribution when it is not declared.
cannot_2: Assume every Siraitia-containing product has the same extract composition or regulatory status.

sources.label: FDA — Aspartame and Other Sweeteners in Food (monk fruit section)
